# `percentile_disc`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
percentile_disc(percentage) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col)
```

Return a percentile value based on a discrete distribution of numeric or ANSI interval column `col` at the given `percentage` (specified in ORDER BY clause).

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- percentile_disc, example 1
> SELECT percentile_disc(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col) FROM VALUES (0), (10) AS tab(col);
0.0
```

```sql
-- percentile_disc, example 2
> SELECT percentile_disc(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col) FROM VALUES (INTERVAL '0' MONTH), (INTERVAL '10' MONTH) AS tab(col);
0-0
```
